stem: Damage appears only on leaves touching a wet wall, and repeated inspection finds no pest signs. What is the best technician approach?
choices: Document the spatial/environmental association and keep pest/pathogen status unconfirmed while escalating the condition
Apply a pesticide to the entire room
Ignore the wet wall because scouting concerns only insects
rationale: IPM scouting includes environmental and cultural risk factors. Evidence should be documented without forcing an unsupported biological diagnosis.
